title: alchemilla coriacea var. trunciloba
intro: Alchemilla coriacea var. trunciloba, commonly known as the truncated alpine lady's mantle, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family, known for its unique foliage and medicinal properties. It is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, wounds, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla coriacea var. trunciloba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
